criteria.reason: Passing readBlockingPolicy cases for 'Blocking: must-pass only' and 'Blocking: all criteria'; the test source asserts toEqual({ policy, status: 'declared', raw }).
Passing cases: no heading, a heading with no line (both asserting policy 'all', status 'absent'), and the CLI case 'a missing file reads as the default, absent'.
Passing cases 'an unrecognised value is invalid and names the line' (asserting policy null, status 'invalid') and 'two Blocking lines are invalid and name both'.

Passing command-surface test asserts implement-trd.md §8.1a stops dispatch on an invalid policy naming the raw line; the prose (implement-trd.md:1867-1873, verify-build.md:293-295) says the workflow is not dispatched and quotes <raw>; the workflow itself also rejects any other blocking value before any agent runs.

Passing workflow test: a stuck exit over a non-must-pass not_met FS-1 (FS-2 must-pass, met) ends outcome 'satisfied' under blocking 'must-pass', and the synced state JSON is asserted to carry outcome 'satisfied'; a converted stalled exit likewise syncs 'satisfied'.

Passing decideNext case "'must-pass' before the cap with gaps open: remediate, never converted mid-loop", plus the workflow case 'a stall the script replaces with remediate is not converted by the blocking policy: the run goes on'.

Passing test asserts result.nonBlocking equals [{id:'FS-1',reason:'r-FS-1'}] and the synced state JSON carries the same nonBlocking; the state-sync prompt (verify-functional.js:2206-2216) writes nonBlocking into the report input and re-runs render-report, and renderReport's 'prints the Not blocking line right after Reason' test passes.

Passing test 'writes one product follow-up row per entry' asserts one discovered row per id with rankClass 'product', blocksFeature false and a '[non-blocking]' summary; both commands run record-nonblocking after each workflow return.
Passing cases "'must-pass' with an unbuilt criterion: exit-unbuilt" (decideNext) and 'a stuck exit over an unbuilt criterion is not converted under must-pass' (workflow).
Passing cases "'must-pass' with no must-pass criterion: inert, exit-stuck" (decideNext) and the workflow case asserting outcome stuck and nonBlocking [].

Passing cases: 'a converted exit below the coverage floor is re-labelled exit-insufficient-coverage', 'a converted exit with a must-pass criterion not verifiable is exit-must-pass-unproven', and the workflow equivalents.

Passing cases "'must-pass' with a must-pass id among the gaps: exit-stuck unchanged" (and at a stall), and the workflow cases where an open must-pass failure becomes stuck under both settings with nonBlocking [].

Passing cases "blocking 'all': unchanged, exit-stuck and no nonBlocking key" and 'no blocking key: a non-must-pass gap at the cap stays exit-stuck'; the full pre-existing suites also pass (1097/1097).

Passing cases assert decideNext's result has no nonBlocking property under no key and under 'all'; the Judge's decide-next payload carries no blocking key; no state sync mentions nonBlocking without a policy; renderReport is byte-identical without nonBlocking.

Passing command-surface test asserts verify-build.md fix-round step 2 says every id in the latest state's nonBlocking is never recorded as a failing row nor counted in buildableOpen (verify-build.md:683-684).
